simple.meaning: פָּרַץ (pârats) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to break out (in many applications, direct and indirect, literal and figurative).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 50 times across Genesis, Exodus, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 2 Kings, and 10 more, beginning at Genesis 28:14. Its contexts include family, flock, kingship, priesthood, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פָּרַץ (H6555).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: פָּרַץ (pârats) / H6555 is traced through Genesis 28:14, Genesis 30:30, Genesis 30:43, Genesis 38:29 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to break out (in many applications, direct and indirect, literal and figurative)
definitions.usage: × abroad, (make a) breach, break (away, down, -er, forth, in, up), burst out, come (spread) abroad, compel, disperse, grow, increase, open, press, scatter, urge.
definitions.full: H6555. parats I. מָּרַץ verb break through (Late Hebrew id. ; Jewish-Aramaic מְּרַץ id. ; perhaps Assyrian parâƒu (see Dl HWB ); Arabic cut, slit , also hit ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular מָּרַץ 2Sam 5:20 +; 2 masculine singular suffix מְּרַצְתָּנוּ Psa 60:3 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִפְרֹץ Exod 1:12 ; 19:22 , יִרְְָץֿ v 24, זַיִּפְרֹץ Gen 30:30 +, etc.; Infinitive absolute מָּרֹץ Isa 5:5 ; construct מְּרֹץ 2Chr 31:5 , מְּרוֺץ Eccl 3:3 ; Participle active מֹּרֵץ Micah 2:13 ; Eccl 10:8 ; passive feminine singular מָּרוּצָה 2Chr 32:5 ; Prov 25:28 ; masculine plural מְּרֻצִים Neh 4:1 + מָּרוּצִים הֵם 2:13 Qr (> Kt המפרוצים ); — break through: 1 break or burst out , from womb Gen 38:29 (J; with accusative of congnate meaning with verb); from enclosure Micah 2:13 . 2 break through, down (from without), with accusative גָּדֵר Isa 5:5 ; Psa 80:13 ; 89:41 ; Eccl 10:8 ; חוֺמָה Nehemiah 3:35; 2Chr 26:6 , compare passive participle Neh 2:13 ; 2Chr 32:5 ; with בְּחוֺמָה = make a breach in 2Kin 14:13 2Chr 25:23 ; מְּרוּצָה עִיר Prov 25:28 ; absolute, opposed to בָּנָה Eccl 3:3 ; הַמֹּרֵץ Micah 2:13 ; הַמְּרוּצִים Neh 4:1 the part broken down. 3 break into , with accusative י ׳בֵּית 2Chr 24:7 . 4 break open , a mining shaft Job 28:4 . 5 break up, break in pieces , with accusative מַעֲשֶׂיךָ 2Chr 20:37 (|| אֳנִיּוֺת וַּיִּשָּֽׁבְרוּ ). 6 break put (violently) upon , of ׳י in sudden judgment, with accusative of person 2Sam 5:20 = 1Chr 14:11 ; Psa 60:3 ; c, ב person Exod 19:22 , 24 (J), I Chron 15:13 , so of plague Psa 106:29 ; of ׳י , with accusative of congnate meaning with verb מֶּרֶין + ב person 2Sam 6:8 = 1Chr 13:11 ; with accusative of congnate meaning with verb + suffix Job 16:14 . 7 use violence absolute Hosea 4:2 . 8 break over [limits], increase , לָרֹב וַיִפְרֹץ Gen 30:30 (J), 1Chr 4:38 ; + ה locative Gen 28:14 (J); absolute 30:43 (J), Exod 1:12 (J; + רָבָה ), Hosea 4:10 ; Isa 54:3 , בָּאָרֶץ מָּרַץ Job 1:10 . 9 burst open , intransitive, of wine-vats Prov 3:10 (with accusative of material תִּירוֺשׁ ). 10 spread , i.e. become known, of הַדָּבָר 2Chr 31:5 . — 1Chr 13:2 is probably corrupt, see Kau, who (after SS) conjectures נֶחֱרָצָה ; ׳פ in 2Chr 11:23 is apparently distributive (with מִן partitive) but dubious. — 1Sam 28:23 ; 2Sam 13:25 , 27 ; 2Kin 5:23 see פצר . Niph`al Participle נִפְרָ֑ץ חָזוֺן אֵין 1Sam 3:1 no vision spread abroad (i.e. General, or frequent, compare Qal 10 ; || י ׳דְּבַר יָקָר הָיָה , but text dubious. Pu`al Participle feminine מְפֹרָ֑צֶת Neh 1:3 (of wall). Hithpa`el Participle plural הַמִּתְמָּֽרְצִים 1Sam 25:10 slaves who break away , each from ( מִמְּנֵי ) his master.
